name: Webform Extra Field
description: Adds a configurable 'Webform' pseudo-field to entity displays, letting an admin place a chosen webform in a bundle's Manage Display among the real fields.
project_description: Provides an extra field (pseudo-field) for placing a webform in an entity's display. An administrator first picks which content-entity bundles get the extra field on a settings form, then on each bundle's Manage Display the 'Webform' pseudo-field can be enabled, positioned and assigned a specific webform to render. The same chosen webform is shown on every entity of that bundle in that view mode. Built on the Extra Field Plus module (part of the Extra Field project) for its per-display settings, and requires the Webform module. Inspired by the Breadcrumb Extra Field project.
